name: realtime
description: Open-source realtime collaboration platform and SDKs

scripts.build: npm run build -w @realtime/protocol && npm run build -w @realtime/core && npm run build -w @realtime/node && npm run build -w @realtime/react && npm run build -w @realtime/editor && npm run build -w @realtime/media
scripts.test: npm run test -w @realtime/protocol && npm run test -w @realtime/platform && npm run test -w @realtime/editor && npm run test -w @realtime/media && npm run test -w @realtime/sample-integrator && node --test scripts/pack-install.test.mjs

author: Sourabh Punase
